title: Decision Table — Corrected-Refiling Delivery Charge (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
For a corrected refiling of a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate, the corrected-refiling delivery charge follows how the certificate travels and the calendar days from today to the effective date requested on a signed insured cancellation request for the certified Cardinal Personal Auto Policy.

| Certificate travels by | Certified policy's signed insured cancellation request | Corrected-refiling delivery charge |
|---|---|---|
| Paper mail | Requested effective date 14 or fewer calendar days from today (the policy ends within 14 days) | 24.50 (courier) |
| Paper mail | Requested effective date more than 14 days from today | 9.85 (certified mail) |
| Paper mail | No signed insured cancellation request on record | 9.85 (certified mail) |
| Electronic transmission | Any | None |

**Which request.** Only an insured cancellation request for the certified policy whose status is signed counts; where more than one is on record, the latest is read. An unsigned request is not a signed cancellation request.

**How a certificate travels.** The transmission method in the certificate's timetable.

## Edge cases (hypothetical, today 1 April)

| Requested cancellation effective date | Days from today | Paper-mail certificate |
|---|---|---|
| 15 April | 14 | 24.50 |
| 16 April | 15 | 9.85 |
| None signed | — | 9.85 |
